title: Dominic and the Kitchen
author: Marguerite Blackwood
blurb: Paloma Voss, a single parent running the town's only bookshop, has spent fifteen years rebuilding a life measured in small safe steps. Then a fake date to survive a family reunion feels too real by dessert — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must forgive the person in the mirror first before the vineyard's first harvest comes in.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
